statements.statement: CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed for this patient
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Diagnosis codes I48.0 and I48.91 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization
Continuous rhythm assessment was indicated to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmia
